avis.titre: Perfect for my acne prone sensitive skin
avis.texte: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ This product has been a game changer for my skin. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and was looking for something gentle that would help with breakouts without drying me out or causing irritation, and this has been amazing. The spray is super easy to use and feels refreshing on the skin. I’ve been using it after workouts, before skincare, and anytime my skin feels irritated or congested. Within a couple weeks I noticed fewer breakouts, less redness, and my skin overall looked calmer and healthier. What I love most is how gentle the hypochlorous acid formula is. It doesn’t sting, leave residue, or make my skin feel tight like harsher acne products often do. It’s also been great for hormonal breakouts and helping my pores look cleaner. I appreciate that it works for all skin types and ages, and the large bottle lasts a long time. Definitely one of those products I didn’t expect to love this much but now use every single day!

Such a steal, and a great dupe for the tower 28 spray – not only do you get more product but it’s cheaper as well. I have been using this for a month now, and as someone that struggles with redness and acne this is made a noticeable difference. I use this as a toner, morning and night while my face is wet and let it fully dry down, and it really helped to prevent acne, even acne I noticed coming in and practically got rid of my redness. It’s also a sensitive formula, you can use this on children on well and to disinfect anything, from furniture to bedding. I have nothing bad to say about this, except that it may not be as concentrated as other formulas but that’s probably what makes it better for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: it is NOT BLEACH!! IT IS SAFE 4 MOST!!! GREAT PRODUCT!!
avis.texte: ITS NOT Bleach, it's SAFE.. ⬇️⬇️⬇️⬇️⬇️⬇️⬇️⬇️⬇️ People in reviews mention this because SkinSmart Antimicrobial Spray contains hypochlorous acid (HOCl), which shares an extremely close chemical relationship with bleach, causes a similar "swimming pool" smell, and behaves identically when tested by reviewers.The comparison stems from three specific factors:1. The Chemical RealityLiquid household bleach is sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl) dissolved in water. When a manufacturer creates an antimicrobial facial mist like SkinSmart, they use electrolysis on saltwater to generate hypochlorous acid (HOCl).Chemically, hypochlorous acid and the hypochlorite ion in bleach exist in a fluid equilibrium inside water. The only major difference dictating which one dominates is the pH level:At a high pH (alkaline): The solution becomes household bleach, which breaks down skin tissue.At a neutral or slightly acidic pH (around 5.5 to 6.5): The solution turns into hypochlorous acid, which is incredibly gentle on human tissue while remaining lethal to bacteria.2. The Shared SmellBecause they are molecular cousins, SkinSmart naturally releases a faint, distinctive chlorine or "pool water" odor right when you spray it. Since the company does not add artificial fragrances to mask this, users immediately associate the scent with household bleach or chlorine.3. I also have HS and I've read that hypochlorous acid spray can help with reducing bacteria and flare ups. I spray it on my armpits and between my thighs. Packaging problem with this - the product did not come with the cap that it usually has and wrapping was torn.

5/5 product for me! I love this. I work a blue collar job where I have to wear a hardhat for 12 hours and all the sweat on my head/forehead was causing fungal acne not only do I spray my face in the middle of my shift but I also spray my hard hat a couple times throughout my shift and in literally just 1 week of using it it cleared my skin up so much. I have combo skin (oily on my T zone). This is definitely a staple for me now. Btw this product has a ‘bleach’ like scent if you’re sensitive to smells it goes away after a few minutes. Doesn’t leave a sticky feeling afterwards.

I’ve used hyperchlorous acid sprays for years and across a wide price range, up to $65 for the Hydrinity one. This one is my favorite! I find it to be most effective. It really made a difference in my skin when I began using it regularly compared to what the other brands did for me. I’m shocked how low the price is. I use it on my face, chest, shoulders and back.

avis.titre: Great for backne if you're active!
avis.texte: Great product. The bottle doesn't necessarily spray a mist, but it's a standard spray and overall has great coverage. I got this for my backne that developed after starting running and it's been a lifesaver in addition to using a SA body wash. I've also tried it on a few wounds and it's great for cleaning without burning. No irritation or drying and it seems to have limited ingredients. The bottle is large and lasts awhile with daily use.

I’ve been using hypochlorous acid on my face and on any small skin abrasions for over a year now. It’s a must have at my house. This item is an affordable alternative to some higher priced items. The spray is more fine than some other brands, so you can get a nice even coating without being dripping wet. It dries quickly so you can move forward with the day fast. It does smell slightly like pool water, but that’s standard with these products and goes away as soon as it dries.

I’m 35 years old and have had acne since forever. I have been using this instead of a facial cleanser every morning, instead of actually washing my face. And my skin has changed for the better! I simply spray some on a cotton pad and some on my face and use the cotton pad to wash my face. Followed by my regular skin care. I will also spray my face after a work out or sweating. Overall I love it and it’s now a subscription order!

As an acne suffer for almost 20 years this product has single-handedly changed my skin for the better! I recommend this to anyone with acne! I only wish that I found it sooner! When you first spray it, it smells like pool but once it dries, can’t even tell, use it every night after a shower before putting on skincare.

avis.titre: Only thing that worked for me
avis.texte: I get impetigo fairly regularly. Mostly from a mixture of chronic skin picking and being around children. This is the only solution that I have found that has help with my acne and impetigo. The pictures shown are less than a week apart (I was also on antibiotics). This spray has helped keep my skin clear since. I use it after I wash my face. It's super simple and travel friendly.

Used this once. Completely broke my face out in tiny little pimple like bumps all over my face and neck. My face was on fire the next day and hurt so bad. I used this prior to my workout the day before and didn’t notice the rash until later that day. I immediately washed my face when I noticed but it was too late. Don’t even risk it. It’s not worth it.
